events.factual_description: Smoke Jazz Club presents George Cables from Wednesday, September 2 through Sunday, September 6, 2026 in a program centered on The George Cables Songbook. The announced group is Cables on piano, Craig Handy on tenor saxophone and flute, Essiet Okon Essiet on bass, Jerome Jennings on drums, and special guest Sarah Elizabeth Charles on vocals. Smoke lists 6:30 PM and 8:30 PM dinner shows throughout the five-night residency, with additional 10:00 PM shows on Friday September 4 and Saturday September 5. George Cables's official site documents The George Cables Songbook as a collection of his compositions and identifies Sarah Elizabeth Charles as the lyricist and vocalist on several pieces, with Craig Handy also featured on the recording.

en.why_it_matters: This belongs on RADAR because the center of gravity is Cables's own writing, not a standards set wrapped around a famous pianist. Sarah Elizabeth Charles has already turned several of his instrumental pieces into songs by writing lyrics for them, while Craig Handy, Essiet Okon Essiet, and Jerome Jennings give the music enough history and flexibility to keep the songbook alive rather than fixed. It is a useful chance to hear a major living pianist-composer presented through his own vocabulary in the kind of room where touch, pacing, and ensemble response are the point.
en.trip_verdict: Keep it on the board if New York is already in play and take a set if it fits the schedule. The five-night run offers enough flexibility that I would not build a dedicated DMV-to-New York trip around it or displace a rarer premiere, farewell, reunion, or one-off.

es.why_it_matters: Ésta merece RADAR porque el centro de gravedad está en la escritura de Cables, no en un set de standards montado alrededor de un pianista famoso. Sarah Elizabeth Charles ya convirtió varias de sus piezas instrumentales en canciones al escribirles letra, mientras Craig Handy, Essiet Okon Essiet y Jerome Jennings le dan al repertorio suficiente historia y elasticidad para que el cancionero siga vivo y no quede congelado. Es una buena oportunidad para escuchar a un gran pianista-compositor vivo desde su propio vocabulario, en una sala donde importan el toque, el manejo del tiempo y la respuesta del ensamble.
es.trip_verdict: Vale tenerla en el tablero si Nueva York ya está en juego e ir a uno de los sets si encaja en el calendario. Cinco noches dan suficiente margen para no armar un viaje dedicado DMV→Nueva York sólo por esta residencia ni desplazar un estreno, despedida, reunión o one-off más raro.
